PC: Learner may assess patient, including brief assessment of airway, cardiovascular, pulmonary, and neurologic systems.
Learner may decide to place central line prior to induction and/or proceed with emergent GA.
Learner may choose GA with RSI with etomidate as induction agent.
Learner may choose GA with RSI with propofol as induction agent.
Learner may choose GA with RSI with fentanyl & ketamine as induction agent.
Learner may attempt cardioversion to regain sinus rhythm.
MK: Learner may identify precipitating events: hypovolemia, onset of junctional rhythm with loss of atrial kick.
SBP: Calls for help and institutes advanced cardiac life support (ACLS)
Learner may call for TEE probe.
Learner may request crash cart brought into the OR and paddles placed on patient.
ICS: Alerts surgical team about cardiovascular changes
Learner may instruct surgeons to stop surgery until patient becomes more stable.
